resources.string: What survives when a conversation outgrows the context: full history, window, rolling summary or extracted facts.

Small engines only fit 1k to 2k tokens. This replays a scripted conversation, states the facts early, and asks about them at the end. Each strategy decides what to keep; the score is how many of the early facts the answer still has.
%1$d turns, about %2$d tokens in full. Budget for the prompt: %3$d tokens.
No engine is usable right now; download a model or configure a key first.
Sends every turn. Exact, but it overflows small engines.
Keeps only the newest turns that fit. What was said early is forgotten.
The model compresses the older turns; the newest stay word for word.
The model pulls durable facts out once; the question sees only the relevant ones.
Over the budget: a small engine would truncate or reject this prompt.
Summaries and facts are written by the same engine you picked, so a weak engine also summarizes badly. That cost is part of the comparison.
prompt ~%1$d tok over the %2$d tok budget
